description: Welcome to Edgar Suites.Want to see the capital's must-sees? Discover this charming house at the end of the courtyard of a residential building in the Latin Quarter, just 500 meters from Notre-Dame. The area is also known for its bookstores, including the famous Shakespeare and Company and its famous restaurants, cafes and galleries.This house on 3 levels can accommodate up to 10 people.The Edgar Suites teams look forward to welcoming you. :)The spaceThe house offers the perfect alliance between a boutique hotel with services and a comfortable Parisian pied-à-terre, carefully decorated, with all the comforts necessary for a short-term stay in Paris.You will find a cleanliness worthy of a hotel, excellent bedding, plenty of storage space, quality linens and towels, Rituals brand toiletries and complete kitchen and household equipment (Nespresso machine with capsules, kettle with tea bags, microwave, dishwasher, washer / dryer, toaster…).A washing machine and a dryer are at your disposal.The house have a spacious living room, a kitchen area with a double sofa bed, 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms and an equipped kitchen. It also has everything you need to telecommute effectively.The bedrooms have air conditioning but not the living rooms on the ground floor.Our travelers are families, groups, professionals.At Edgar Suites, we make every effort to ensure that your stay is comfortable and that communication is as fluid as possible with our guests.Edgar and his team look forward to welcoming you :)Guest accessTravelers will have access to the entire house.
